verdict.rationale: Medusa documents an official, hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server at https://docs.medusajs.com/mcp that can be added to MCP-capable agents such as Cursor, and a probe confirms the documentation page exists. The pricing page also lists "Medusa MCP and Cloud CLI" as a Cloud feature. However, the documented server only exposes Medusa documentation lookup, not store or commerce operations, and the Cloud-side MCP is a bare one-line mention. Missing for 10: documented MCP tools for operating store data (products, orders, admin actions), detailed docs for the Cloud "Medusa MCP" offering, independent or hands-on corroboration.
